$comment: PRD section 20.1 'Monorepo layout' transcribed verbatim from docs/PRD.md (the fenced text block).
`source` keeps the original brace notation line by line; `directories` is that notation expanded.
The layout test reads the FILESYSTEM, not the git index, so renaming a directory in the worktree fails it.
TRACKED top-level directories that are outside PRD section 20.1 and are legitimately part of
this repository: repository tooling predating FND-01 (.claude, .github, templates, tools) plus
agent-pipeline tooling adopted since — .agents (Codex skills) and .codex (Codex config and
scripts), both installed 2026-08-12 by `npx agent-templates@latest adopt` of the two upstream
three-agent architect/builder/reviewer patterns, and both tracked in git.
The key NAME is now narrower than its contents, deliberately: renaming it would mean editing
tools/workspace-assertions.mjs, which FND-19 (a one-file repair) does not touch.
ESCAPE HATCH — when the repository root legitimately gains a directory, add it HERE if it is
tracked, or to topLevelIgnored if it is git-ignored and never committed, together with its
basis and date. Never add it to `source`/`directories`: those are a verbatim transcription of
PRD section 20.1 and change only when the PRD does. Never widen the check itself — no
wildcard, prefix or dot-prefix rule, no skipped test, no removal of the unexpected-directory
loop. Establish first what the directory is (tracked or ignored, decided or accidental); an
accidental one is deleted or git-ignored, not allowed. FND-19.
Untracked build/tooling artifacts; all are git-ignored, none may be committed. .worktrees is
the root-level harness worktree directory used at concurrency > 1 (.gitignore line 31:
'agent-templates: root-level harness worktrees — never commit, never scan'); .claude/worktrees
and .codex/worktrees are nested, not top-level, and need no entry here.
STATIC ENUMERATION, and this is load-bearing: assertLayout() performs NO git access at all —
it is a pure readdirSync/statSync read — so being git-ignored does not by itself exempt a
directory. A new git-ignored top-level directory must be added to this list explicitly.
The guard is deliberately NOT made to consult git: (1) .gitignore is itself writable by the
00-foundation module, so an 'anything git-ignored is allowed' rule would let one unrelated
appended line retire the layout guard for any directory; (2) tools/tests/layout.test.mjs runs
assertLayout against mkdtemp scratch roots that contain no git repository at all, so git
queries there would fail or answer from the machine's global ignore file. FND-19.
